children: AMSTERDAM, Sept. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- OCI Global N.V. ("OCI" or the "Company") (Euronext: OCI) confirms that on 16 September 2026 it received from Oceanwood Capital Management LLP the attached open letter, written on behalf of a group of three shareholders in the Company. OCI is publishing the letter for information purposes only, without comment or endorsement.
– Open letter to the Board of OCI Global N.V., 16 September 2026
Learn more about OCI at www.oci-global.com. You can also follow OCI on LinkedIn.
